Execution is gated by depends_on: do not start until every blocker item is terminal or a supervisor waives sequencing.

Allowlist paths are proposed targets and may be refined by upstream packet outputs; keep changes within the declared allowlist.
PR Steward is not merge authority and green CI is not semantic proof (AIR Red Lines #7/#8).
READY is blocked by stale proof, failed/stale checks, unknown reviewer/bot, unclassified review items, unresolved blocking threads, diff outside allowlist, or missing security/release approval.
